gloss: to think exhaustively; to brood over

definitions.gloss: to think exhaustively; to brood over; to ponder to the limit
definitions.explanation: To keep thinking about something intensely, often dwelling on a worry or problem until one is mentally cornered. Usually carries a sense of unhealthy over-thinking.

examples.japanese: {一人|ひとり}で{考|かんが}え{詰|つ}める。
{問題|もんだい}を{考|かんが}え{詰|つ}めすぎて{眠|ねむ}れない。
examples.english: I thought so hard about the problem that I couldn't sleep.

examples.japanese: {悩|なや}みを{一人|ひとり}で{考|かんが}え{詰|つ}めると、かえって{出口|でぐち}が{見|み}えなくなる。
examples.english: When you brood over a worry by yourself, you paradoxically lose sight of the way out.

notes:
Compound of {考|かんが}える (to think) + {詰|つ}める (to do to the limit). Less common than its near-synonym {思|おも}い{詰|つ}める; somewhat literary.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive, taking を for the matter dwelt on, though it is often used intransitively with no object.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {思|おも}い{詰|つ}める: to brood/obsess — the everyday word for dwelling on a worry; more common
- {突|つ}き{詰|つ}める: to get to the bottom of — implies pursuing a question to a clear conclusion, not anxious brooding
